project.title: PROJECT ZONE
project.description: PROJECT ZONE is an independent Unity 6 URP open-zone FPS RPG. Explore a dangerous exclusion zone, fight hostiles, scavenge gear, complete contracts, and return to safety. Built with HQ FPS Weapons 2.0 and Emerald AI 2026, bridged by custom Project Zone adapters.

publicPolicy.note: Public hub data is allowlisted. Issue bodies, private notes, credentials, and local paths are never published. Until GitHub sync succeeds, the site shows planning catalog data labeled as unverified.

milestones.title: Unity & HQ FPS Foundation
milestones.description: Establish the Unity 6 URP project, integrate HQ FPS Weapons 2.0, validate player movement and weapons, and lock project isolation rules.

milestones.title: Emerald AI Integration
milestones.description: Bridge HQ FPS Weapons damage into Emerald AI and Emerald damage into the player, then validate detection, pursuit, combat, and death reactions.
scope: HQ FPS to Emerald damage adapter
Emerald to HQ FPS damage adapter

requirements.title: HQ FPS to Emerald damage adapter
Emerald to HQ FPS damage adapter

milestones.title: The Outskirts
milestones.description: Build the first playable region with a safe settlement, abandoned checkpoint, industrial building, underground entrance, and atmospheric NPC placement.

milestones.title: Inventory & Persistence
milestones.description: Add loot, backpack UI, permanent stash, inventory transfers, and verified save/load for equipment and items.

milestones.title: Death & Contracts
milestones.description: Complete the expedition loop with hybrid death rules, recoverable caches, currency, repeatable contracts, and progression rewards.

activity.title: Milestone 3 completed — The Outskirts
activity.summary: PZ_Outskirts greybox region, NPCs/NavMesh, and atmosphere systems signed off in Play Mode. Issues #14–#20 closed. Art/fog polish remains follow-up.

activity.title: Outskirts region greybox verified
activity.summary: Play Mode confirmed PZ_Outskirts walkable greybox (Settlement, Checkpoint, Industrial, UndergroundEntrance). Issue #14 closed.

activity.title: Milestone 2 completed — package compatibility signed off
activity.summary: HQ FPS Weapons 2.0 and Emerald AI adapters verified together on Unity 6 URP. Issue #13 closed; Milestone 2 complete. Melee hostile remains optional scene follow-up.

activity.title: Death and hit reactions verified
activity.summary: Play Mode confirmed AI hit reactions, AI death, HQ player death, and post-death damage ignore. Issue #12 closed.

activity.title: Ranged combat validation verified
activity.summary: Two-way ranged combat confirmed: player damages Emerald hostiles and ranged AI damages the HQ FPS player. Issue #11 closed (melee deferred until a melee hostile is added).

activity.title: Enemy detection and pursuit verified
activity.summary: Hostile Emerald AI units now detect and pursue the HQ FPS player through Project Zone target adapters. Issue #10 closed.

activity.title: Milestone 1 completed
activity.summary: Unity 6 URP foundation, HQ FPS Weapons 2.0 integration, player movement and weapon validation, and project isolation rules confirmed.

activity.title: Two-way combat damage bridges verified
activity.summary: Player firearms damage Emerald AI hostiles, and Emerald attacks damage the HQ FPS player through Project Zone combat adapters.

devlog.title: Enemy detection and pursuit verified
devlog.body: Issue #10 closed after Play Mode confirmation. Emerald AI hostiles detect and pursue the HQ FPS player via Project Zone target adapters.

devlog.title: Milestone 1 — Unity & HQ FPS Foundation
devlog.body: Confirmed complete: Unity 6 URP project setup, HQ FPS Weapons 2.0 integration, player movement and weapon validation, Git repository initialization, and the permanent Cursor project isolation rule.

devlog.title: Two-way combat damage bridges verified
devlog.body: Milestone 2 damage adapters are functional. Player shots register on Emerald AI hostiles, and Emerald attacks reach the HQ FPS player health system. Remaining work: melee/ranged combat validation, death/hit reactions, and package compatibility sign-off.
